summary: An intranet platform for visualizing graduate study-room seats, accepting student seat applications, and managing approvals, assignments, room layouts, and legacy spreadsheet data.

architecture.notes: A single repository exposes pnpm dev as the development entry point, running the Next.js frontend and the FastAPI backend together. PostgreSQL is the source of truth; students use the public intranet interface without accounts, while one administrator authenticates from environment-configured credentials.

components.name: Student web interface
components.description: Shows published room layouts and lists, exposes occupant names, and accepts seat applications without student login.

components.name: Administrator web interface
components.description: Reviews applications, manages assignments and reference data, edits room layouts, imports legacy data, and configures SMTP.

components.name: Floor-plan editor
components.description: Provides a constrained drag-and-drop seat-map editor with generated seat grids and simple room fixtures instead of CAD tools.

components.name: FastAPI service
components.description: Enforces application, approval, assignment, authentication, import, audit, and email-delivery rules.

components.name: PostgreSQL database
components.description: Stores rooms, seats, layouts, student records, applications, assignments, settings, delivery records, and audit history.

components.name: SMTP integration
components.description: Sends approval outcomes using administrator-configured server settings and records delivery attempts.
